neighbours.label: ' twice' as a recurring frequency after an event verb (held twice a year), not 'twice as much' or 'twice already'
fire: The fair is held twice a year in the town square.
The ferry crosses the bay twice a day.
The council meets twice a month at city hall.
The market opens twice a week in summer.
The choir performs twice a year at the abbey.
The river floods the fields twice a year.
The magazine comes out twice a year in Dutch.
The priest blesses the boats twice a month.
quiet: The fair is twice as big as the one in the town square.
The ferry is twice the size of the old boat.
The council has twice the budget of city hall.
The market opens each week in summer.
The choir performs every spring at the abbey.
The river floods the fields each year.
The magazine costs twice as much in Dutch.
The priest has told the boatmen twice already.

predictions: Recurring ' twice' fires; multiplier ' twice', 'twice already' and 'each year' stay quiet. ' type', ' part' and ' person' also fired weakly and are outside this label.
